title: North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund Amendment Ordinance 2006

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Short title, and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 2006
ORDINANCE II OF 2006
North-West Frontier Province Hydel
Development Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance, further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development
Fund Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary 24th August, 2006]
1. Short title, and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXVI of 2001

ORDINANCE II OF 2006
ORDINANCE II OF 2006
North-West Frontier Province Hydel
Development Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance, further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development
Fund Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary 24th August, 2006]
2. Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXVI
of 2001.---In the North-West Frontier Province Hydel
Development Fund Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXVI
of 2001), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3, after
subsection (8), the following new subsection shall be added, namely:-‑
"(9) An
Investment Committee, consisting of the following, shall be constituted to make
recommendation to the Board for making investment out of the Fund.
(1) Chief Secretary to Government.
Chairman
(2) Secretary to Government
Irrigation and Power Department
Member
(3) Secretary to Government
Finance Department
Member
(4) Managing Director, SITYDO.
Member
(5) Director Finance and
Administration SITYDO.
Member. "
